items.work_item: Complete and record the Apple Silicon baseline build and focused tests

Build time, startup time, and package size are measured

items.work_item: Create the production macOS bundle, DMG, PKG, signing, notarization, SBOM, and provenance pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Apple Silicon artifacts pass all gates
Credential-free pipeline parts pass in CI

items.work_item: Implement the beginner-first application shell and AI run states
acceptance_criteria: A new user can create a project without selecting a workbench or engine
Validation cannot change the canonical CAD file, accepted head, project manifest, accepted project entries, or accepted project-state hash
Accept creates exactly one revision and Reject or Stop creates no revision

items.work_item: Add the versioned design brief and revision provenance schemas
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted AI mutation writes a complete revision record
Old project data migrates without loss

items.work_item: Unify native and scripted candidate validation, review, and acceptance
test_requirements: canonical and head invariance during review
acceptance_criteria: A failed candidate never replaces the accepted revision
A validated candidate remains pending until an explicit human or automatic decision
Reject and Stop restore the prior byte-exact CAD and project state
Inspection cannot change accepted project metadata

items.work_item: Bind accepted CAD and project artifacts to each revision and implement transactional restore and comparison
acceptance_criteria: Failed provenance writes cannot leave unrecorded accepted geometry
Failed CAD saves cannot advance the revision head
Restore verifies and applies matching CAD, project state, metadata, and head

items.work_item: Implement automatic modeling strategy and Tier 1 and Tier 2 benchmark workflows
test_requirements: versioned automatic strategy routing and structure preservation
Tier 1 deterministic provider transaction benchmark for all seven classes
Tier 1 live-model benchmark with human ratings by provider and model
acceptance_criteria: Tier 1 live-model completion is at least 95 percent by case attempt for each claimed provider and model
Tier 2 live-model completion is at least 85 percent by case attempt or each failure is retained and documented
Deterministic and live-model completion rates remain separate

items.work_item: Complete assemblies, drawings, manufacturing, BOM, and advanced export workflows
acceptance_criteria: Tier 3 workflows produce editable and reopenable documents

items.work_item: Add a bounded, privacy-safe provider readiness preflight

Live benchmarks start only for a valid configured provider

items.work_item: Expose revision reports and duplicate accepted CAD revisions as branches

items.work_item: Add safe scale calibration and estimated dimensions for reference images
acceptance_criteria: An uncalibrated image cannot supply an exact dimension

items.work_item: Add structured guided FDM manufacturing analysis
